Repair and extend the H3Act offline evidence pipeline in `/workspace/project`.
Its typed payload models, frame adapter and client replay must work together
with compressed byte expressions and the origin-capture audit extension.
Produce exact client receipts, lifecycle outcomes, HTTP/1.1 request boundaries,
body summaries, source-byte attribution and paired evidence diagnostics.
The complete input/output and timing contract is `/workspace/PROTOCOL.md`.
Runtime, dependency, submission-tree and syscall limits are in `RUNTIME.md`.
The initial project has real integration defects and unfinished extension modules.
Keep useful behavior while implementing the complete documented domain.
You may reorganize the project or add source/data files within the tree budget.
Submit the whole `/workspace/project` tree; its CLI entry is `main.py`.
Use CPython3.11.14 and the provisioned Pydantic2.12.5 dependency set.
Run `cd /workspace/project && python3 -B main.py < /workspace/sample.json`.
Run `python3 /workspace/check.py /workspace/project` for public sanity checks.
The program reads one UTF-8 JSON object and writes one JSON object, without args.
Public checks cover only small examples; all published domain rules apply.


Work in /workspace. When finished run exactly: echo COMPLETE_TASK_AND_SUBMIT_FINAL_OUTPUT
items.finalText:
All verification complete. The pipeline is fully repaired and extended:

**Summary of the work:**

1. **`modules/byte_program.py`** — completed the compressed byte-program: `Lit`/`Cat`/`Rep` nodes supporting concat, repetition and byte slices *without materializing* expanded content, with O(log n) fingerprints over huge repetitions (binary-doubling monoid), bounded window access for line scanning, and `Context` implementing the full expression grammar (AST depth ≤ 128 counting operator/slice/context edges, string/bytes/int literals, earlier-definitions-only names, `+`/`*` typing rules, literal slice endpoints) plus templates (whole `{{...}}` expressions, `<<random_string>>` = first 20 hex chars of SHA256 of `seed/coordinate/occurrence`, per-template occurrence numbering).

2. **`schema.py`** — typed payload models (Pydantic 2.12.5) with exact-key, no-coercion frame validation and coordinate-correct template compilation.

3. **`HTTP3_Just_Send.py`** — repaired client lifecycle: `ok` at send-finish when a response end is already retained (was hanging to timeout), `timeout` at send-finish+timeout_ms with tied response events winning, `closed` semantics for close (pauses/waiters terminated, later emissions prevented, terminal results preserved), `send_error` for post-request-end frames with sleeps still permitted.

4. **`modules/fuzz_adapter.py`** — exact receipt encoding (8-byte time, 4-byte stream, kind byte, encoded content, end byte), frame/payload accounting, response-body fingerprints.

5. **`modules/capture_audit.py`** — HTTP/1.1 request framing over compressed captures (line/8192 limit with the exact incomplete-vs-syntax rules, 65536/128 block limits, Content-Length list rules, TE-conflict rules, chunked bodies with trailer field blocks), precise budget counting points (20,000 requests; 40,000 chunk-size lines counted after the CRLF check and before hex/suffix), half-open offsets, `committed`/`error`, source-byte attribution (`owner`/`owners` with first-occurrence merging), and all paired evidence flags computed from **actual bytes** (never checksums), per request and per case.

6. **`main.py`** — strict whole-input validation (duplicate keys, BOM, surrogates, nonfinite numbers, booleans-as-integers, unknown keys, all inclusive budgets).

Verified with 9 targeted suites (~200 assertions incl. brute-force fingerprint cross-checks), 500 fuzz inputs, the exact fixture match, and the public checker.
